items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Rushing, Ella Fitzgerald, Billie Holiday, Helen Humes, ’Bama.

ctx.x: Yeah, it’s a sequel. As a matter of fact, Louis Armstrong told me one time – I went to see – Dizzy and I used to live close to Pops, in Corona [New York]. There was a whole bunch of us lived in the same area: Dizzy, me, Charlie Shavers, Jimmy
Rushing, Ella Fitzgerald, Billie Holiday, Helen Humes, ’Bama. There was at least 15 . . .
